FX-ENERGYX-001.says: A core 6 across from (4, 5) to (12, 5), no glow, Start and End Roundness 100 written out: D-508's round ends, the frame without them.

FX-ENERGYX-002.says: Start and End Roundness 0: both ends flat, cut square across at x 4 and x 12.

FX-ENERGYX-003.says: Start Roundness 0, End Roundness 100: flat at the left, round at the right.

FX-ENERGYX-004.says: Both 50: each end half an ellipse, half as long as the round end.

FX-ENERGYX-005.says: Both 0 with a glow, spread 6: the core's ends flat, the glow still round past them.

FX-ENERGYX-006.says: End Roundness keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear: the right end rounds out, frames 0, 2 and 4.

FX-ENERGYX-007.says: The box mask as the path, drawn whole, both 0: a closed path drawn whole has no ends, the frame with them round.

FX-ENERGYX-008.says: The box, End offset 50, both 0: half way round, flat at its top-left and bottom-right corners' ends.

FX-ENERGYX-009.says: Both 0, End size 50: the right end flat and half as wide.

FX-ENERGYX-010.says: Both 0 with distortion 1 at scale 3: the ends flat across the wobbled beam's first and last bit.

FX-ENERGYX-011.says: The open roof shape, Start Roundness 0, End Roundness 25, core 4.

FX-ENERGYX-012.says: Noise Along Path on, written out, with distortion 1 at scale 3: D-508's wobble, the frame without the setting.

FX-ENERGYX-013.says: Noise Along Path off: the noise read on the layer, a different wobble.

FX-ENERGYX-014.says: Off on the box, distortion 1.5 at scale 4, speed 0: still joined round the box, the same at frames 0 and 3.

FX-ENERGYX-015.says: Off on the box, speed 50: the wobble moves, frames 0, 1 and 2.

FX-ENERGYX-016.says: Off, End offset keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4: the beam draws on through a wobble that stays put, frames 2 and 4.

FX-ENERGYX-017.says: Alpha Mode masks, the small box (5, 4) to (9, 6) as a mask of mode None: the core and glow only inside it.

FX-ENERGYX-018.says: Alpha Mode core: the core only inside the small box, the glow everywhere.

FX-ENERGYX-019.says: Alpha Mode glow: the glow only inside, the core all along.

FX-ENERGYX-020.says: Alpha Mode masks, Invert Masks on: everything but the inside.

FX-ENERGYX-021.says: Alpha Mode off with the small box: nothing cut, the frame without it.

FX-ENERGYX-022.says: Alpha Mode masks, the small box feathered 2: a soft cut.

FX-ENERGYX-023.says: Two masks, the left six columns in mode Add and the right five in mode None: both cut alike, the mode not read; the Add mask also cuts the drawing, as a mask always does, and the light is added over it.

FX-ENERGYX-024.says: The small box inverted as a mask (its own Inverted): kept outside it.

FX-ENERGYX-025.says: The box as both the path and the cut: the beam along its edge, half of it outside, the core and glow cut at the box's edge.

FX-ENERGYX-026.says: Alpha Mode masks, composite add, the small box: the drawing beneath is not cut, only the light.

FX-ENERGYX-027.says: Alpha Mode masks with no mask. No mask to cut by: the beam is drawn uncut, the effect is kept as written, and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said every frame.

FX-ENERGYX-028.says: Alpha Mode core with the one mask switched off. No mask to cut by: the beam is drawn uncut, the effect is kept as written, and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said every frame.

FX-ENERGYX-029.says: Start roundness -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ENERGYX-030.says: End roundness 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ENERGYX-031.says: Noise Along Path "yes", not "on" or "off". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ENERGYX-032.says: Alpha Mode "enable", not "off", "masks", "core" or "glow". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-ENERGYX-033.says: Invert Masks "1", not "on" or "off". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
